ayahs.arabicText: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْ نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلٰى عَبْدِهٖ لِیَكُوْنَ لِلْعٰلَمِیْنَ نَذِیْرَاۙ
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ لَمْ یَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَّ لَمْ یَكُنْ لَّهٗ شَرِیْكٌ فِی الْمُلْكِ وَ خَلَقَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ فَقَدَّرَهٗ تَقْدِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً لَّا یَخْلُقُوْنَ شَیْئًا وَّ هُمْ یُخْلَقُوْنَ وَ لَا یَمْلِكُوْنَ لِاَنْفُسِهِمْ ضَرًّا وَّ لَا نَفْعًا وَّ لَا یَمْلِكُوْنَ مَوْتًا وَّ لَا حَیٰوةً وَّ لَا نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اِفْكُ اِ۟فْتَرٰىهُ وَ اَعَانَهٗ عَلَیْهِ قَوْمٌ اٰخَرُوْنَ١ۛۚ فَقَدْ جَآءُوْ ظُلْمًا وَّ زُوْرًاۚۛ
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur'an] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْۤا اَسَاطِیْرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ اكْتَتَبَهَا فَهِیَ تُمْلٰى عَلَیْهِ بُكْرَةً وَّ اَصِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَنْزَلَهُ الَّذِیْ یَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِیْمًا
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا مَالِ هٰذَا الرَّسُوْلِ یَاْكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَ یَمْشِیْ فِی الْاَسْوَاقِ١ؕ لَوْ لَاۤ اُنْزِلَ اِلَیْهِ مَلَكٌ فَیَكُوْنَ مَعَهٗ نَذِیْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ یُلْقٰۤى اِلَیْهِ كَنْزٌ اَوْ تَكُوْنُ لَهٗ جَنَّةٌ یَّاْكُلُ مِنْهَا١ؕ وَ قَالَ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ اِنْ تَتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

ayahs.arabicText: اُنْظُرْ كَیْفَ ضَرَبُوْا لَكَ الْاَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوْا فَلَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ سَبِیْلًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

ayahs.arabicText: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْۤ اِنْ شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَیْرًا مِّنْ ذٰلِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ١ۙ وَ یَجْعَلْ لَّكَ قُصُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ كَذَّبُوْا بِالسَّاعَةِ١۫ وَ اَعْتَدْنَا لِمَنْ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِیْرًاۚ
ayahs.translation: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذَا رَاَتْهُمْ مِّنْ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِیْدٍ سَمِعُوْا لَهَا تَغَیُّظًا وَّ زَفِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: When the Hellfire sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَاۤ اُلْقُوْا مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَیِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِیْنَ دَعَوْا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا تَدْعُوا الْیَوْمَ ثُبُوْرًا وَّاحِدًا وَّ ادْعُوْا ثُبُوْرًا كَثِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَذٰلِكَ خَیْرٌ اَمْ جَنَّةُ الْخُلْدِ الَّتِیْ وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ١ؕ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَّ مَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.

ayahs.arabicText: لَهُمْ فِیْهَا مَا یَشَآءُوْنَ خٰلِدِیْنَ١ؕ كَانَ عَلٰى رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْئُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یَحْشُرُهُمْ وَ مَا یَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ فَیَقُوْلُ ءَاَنْتُمْ اَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِیْ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ اَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِیْلَؕ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allah and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا سُبْحٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ یَنْۢبَغِیْ لَنَاۤ اَنْ نَّتَّخِذَ مِنْ دُوْنِكَ مِنْ اَوْلِیَآءَ وَ لٰكِنْ مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَ اٰبَآءَهُمْ حَتّٰى نَسُوا الذِّكْرَ١ۚ وَ كَانُوْا قَوْمًۢا بُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْكُمْ بِمَا تَقُوْلُوْنَ١ۙ فَمَا تَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَ صَرْفًا وَّ لَا نَصْرًا١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّظْلِمْ مِّنْكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ اِلَّاۤ اِنَّهُمْ لَیَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَ یَمْشُوْنَ فِی الْاَسْوَاقِ١ؕ وَ جَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً١ؕ اَتَصْبِرُوْنَ١ۚ وَ كَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِیْرًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَرْجُوْنَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْ لَاۤ اُنْزِلَ عَلَیْنَا الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَوْ نَرٰى رَبَّنَا١ؕ لَقَدِ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا فِیْۤ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ عَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ یَرَوْنَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرٰى یَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِیْنَ وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَدِمْنَاۤ اِلٰى مَا عَمِلُوْا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنْثُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.

ayahs.arabicText: اَصْحٰبُ الْجَنَّةِ یَوْمَئِذٍ خَیْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَّ اَحْسَنُ مَقِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَآءُ بِالْغَمَامِ وَ نُزِّلَ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ تَنْزِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلْمُلْكُ یَوْمَئِذِ اِ۟لْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ١ؕ وَ كَانَ یَوْمًا عَلَى الْكٰفِرِیْنَ عَسِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلٰى یَدَیْهِ یَقُوْلُ یٰلَیْتَنِی اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوْلِ سَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰوَیْلَتٰى لَیْتَنِیْ لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ اَضَلَّنِیْ عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ اِذْ جَآءَنِیْ١ؕ وَ كَانَ الشَّیْطٰنُ لِلْاِنْسَانِ خَذُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الرَّسُوْلُ یٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِی اتَّخَذُوْا هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ مَهْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَذٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِیٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ١ؕ وَ كَفٰى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِیًا وَّ نَصِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَوْ لَا نُزِّلَ عَلَیْهِ الْقُرْاٰنُ جُمْلَةً وَّاحِدَةً١ۛۚ كَذٰلِكَ١ۛۚ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ وَ رَتَّلْنٰهُ تَرْتِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَاْتُوْنَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِئْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَحْسَنَ تَفْسِیْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ یُحْشَرُوْنَ عَلٰى وُجُوْهِهِمْ اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ١ۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّ اَضَلُّ سَبِیْلًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ وَ جَعَلْنَا مَعَهٗۤ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ وَزِیْرًاۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَاۤ اِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِیْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا١ؕ فَدَمَّرْنٰهُمْ تَدْمِیْرًاؕ
ayahs.translation: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَوْمَ نُوْحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ اَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ وَ جَعَلْنٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ اٰیَةً١ؕ وَ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلظّٰلِمِیْنَ عَذَابًا اَلِیْمًاۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ عَادًا وَّ ثَمُوْدَاۡ وَ اَصْحٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَ قُرُوْنًۢا بَیْنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْاَمْثَالَ١٘ وَ كُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْیَةِ الَّتِیْۤ اُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ١ؕ اَفَلَمْ یَكُوْنُوْا یَرَوْنَهَا١ۚ بَلْ كَانُوْا لَا یَرْجُوْنَ نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا رَاَوْكَ اِنْ یَّتَّخِذُوْنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًا١ؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِیْ بَعَثَ اللّٰهُ رَسُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ كَادَ لَیُضِلُّنَا عَنْ اٰلِهَتِنَا لَوْ لَاۤ اَنْ صَبَرْنَا عَلَیْهَا١ؕ وَ سَوْفَ یَعْلَمُوْنَ حِیْنَ یَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ اَضَلُّ سَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.

ayahs.arabicText: اَرَءَیْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُ١ؕ اَفَاَنْتَ تَكُوْنُ عَلَیْهِ وَكِیْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ تَحْسَبُ اَنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ یَسْمَعُوْنَ اَوْ یَعْقِلُوْنَ١ؕ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا كَالْاَنْعَامِ بَلْ هُمْ اَضَلُّ سَبِیْلًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ كَیْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ١ۚ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهٗ سَاكِنًا١ۚ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَیْهِ دَلِیْلًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنٰهُ اِلَیْنَا قَبْضًا یَّسِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّیْلَ لِبَاسًا وَّ النَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَّ جَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْۤ اَرْسَلَ الرِّیٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَیْنَ یَدَیْ رَحْمَتِهٖ١ۚ وَ اَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُوْرًاۙ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water

ayahs.arabicText: لِّنُحْیَِۧ بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّیْتًا وَّ نُسْقِیَهٗ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَاۤ اَنْعَامًا وَّ اَنَاسِیَّ كَثِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ صَرَّفْنٰهُ بَیْنَهُمْ لِیَذَّكَّرُوْا١ۖ٘ فَاَبٰۤى اَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِیْ كُلِّ قَرْیَةٍ نَّذِیْرًا٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ وَ جَاهِدْهُمْ بِهٖ جِهَادًا كَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَیْنِ هٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّ هٰذَا مِلْحٌ اُجَاجٌ١ۚ وَ جَعَلَ بَیْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَّ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهٗ نَسَبًا وَّ صِهْرًا١ؕ وَ كَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا یَنْفَعُهُمْ وَ لَا یَضُرُّهُمْ١ؕ وَ كَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلٰى رَبِّهٖ ظَهِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّ نَذِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ اِلَّا مَنْ شَآءَ اَنْ یَّتَّخِذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِیْلًا
ayahs.translation: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَیِّ الَّذِیْ لَا یَمُوْتُ وَ سَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهٖ١ؕ وَ كَفٰى بِهٖ بِذُنُوْبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِیْرَا٤ۚۛۙ
ayahs.translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا فِیْ سِتَّةِ اَیَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ١ۛۚ اَلرَّحْمٰنُ فَسْئَلْ بِهٖ خَبِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا قِیْلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوْا لِلرَّحْمٰنِ قَالُوْا وَ مَا الرَّحْمٰنُ١ۗ اَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَاْمُرُنَا وَ زَادَهُمْ نُفُوْرًا۠۩ ۞ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.

ayahs.arabicText: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ فِی السَّمَآءِ بُرُوْجًا وَّ جَعَلَ فِیْهَا سِرٰجًا وَّ قَمَرًا مُّنِیْرًا
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ الَّیْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ اَرَادَ اَنْ یَّذَّكَّرَ اَوْ اَرَادَ شُكُوْرًا
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمٰنِ الَّذِیْنَ یَمْشُوْنَ عَلَى الْاَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَّ اِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجٰهِلُوْنَ قَالُوْا سَلٰمًا
ayahs.translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَبِیْتُوْنَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَّ قِیَامًا
ayahs.translation: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ١ۖۗ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًاۗۖ
ayahs.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اِذَاۤ اَنْفَقُوْا لَمْ یُسْرِفُوْا وَ لَمْ یَقْتُرُوْا وَ كَانَ بَیْنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
ayahs.translation: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ وَ لَا یَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِیْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَ لَا یَزْنُوْنَ١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ یَلْقَ اَثَامًاۙ
ayahs.translation: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

ayahs.arabicText: یُّضٰعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ وَ یَخْلُدْ فِیْهٖ مُهَانًاۗۖ
ayahs.translation: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَ اٰمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ یُبَدِّلُ اللّٰهُ سَیِّاٰتِهِمْ حَسَنٰتٍ١ؕ وَ كَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِیْمًا
ayahs.translation: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ تَابَ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاِنَّهٗ یَتُوْبُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَتَابًا
ayahs.translation: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یَشْهَدُوْنَ الزُّوْرَ١ۙ وَ اِذَا مَرُّوْا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوْا كِرَامًا
ayahs.translation: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ یَخِرُّوْا عَلَیْهَا صُمًّا وَّ عُمْیَانًا
ayahs.translation: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّیّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْیُنٍ وَّ اجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ اِمَامًا
ayahs.translation: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ یُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا وَ یُلَقَّوْنَ فِیْهَا تَحِیَّةً وَّ سَلٰمًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.

ayahs.arabicText: خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَا١ؕ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّ مُقَامًا
ayahs.translation: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَا یَعْبَؤُا بِكُمْ رَبِّیْ لَوْ لَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ١ۚ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ یَكُوْنُ لِزَامًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
